candidates.label: Night Journey (Isra) as supreme divine sign linking sacred mosques
candidates.definition: In 17:1: Exalted is He who took His Servant by night from Masjid Haram to Masjid Aqsa whose surroundings We blessed to show him Our signs.

evidence.excerpt: سُبۡحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَسۡرَىٰ بِعَبۡدِهِۦ لَيۡلٗا مِّنَ ٱلۡمَسۡجِدِ ٱلۡحَرَامِ إِلَى ٱلۡمَسۡجِدِ ٱلۡأَقۡصَا ٱلَّذِي بَٰرَكۡنَا حَوۡلَهُۥ لِنُرِيَهُۥ مِنۡ ءَايَٰتِنَآۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡبَصِيرُ

candidates.label: Bani Israel dual corruption-elevation cycle with prophetic warning
candidates.definition: In 17:4-8: Conveyed in Scripture you will cause corruption twice; first promise fulfilled by mighty servants; return victory; final promise enters Masjid.

evidence.excerpt: وَقَضَيۡنَآ إِلَىٰ بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَـٰٓءِيلَ فِي ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ لَتُفۡسِدُنَّ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مَرَّتَيۡنِ وَلَتَعۡلُنَّ عُلُوّٗا كَبِيرٗا

candidates.label: Quran as guide to most suitable with dual outcome
candidates.definition: In 17:9: Indeed this Quran guides to that which is most suitable (aqwam) and gives good tidings to believers doing righteous deeds of great reward.

evidence.excerpt: إِنَّ هَٰذَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ يَهۡدِي لِلَّتِي هِيَ أَقۡوَمُ وَيُبَشِّرُ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَعۡمَلُونَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ أَنَّ لَهُمۡ أَجۡرٗا كَبِيرٗا

candidates.label: Human hastiness in supplication contrasted with divine patience
candidates.definition: In 17:11: Man supplicates for evil as he supplicates for good; man is ever hasty.

evidence.excerpt: وَيَدۡعُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ بِٱلشَّرِّ دُعَآءَهُۥ بِٱلۡخَيۡرِۖ وَكَانَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ عَجُولٗا

candidates.label: Individual responsibility through neck-bound record metaphor
candidates.definition: In 17:13-14: Every person's deeds We attached to his neck; Day of Resurrection bring book wide open read sufficient reckoner against yourself.

evidence.excerpt: وَكُلَّ إِنسَٰنٍ أَلۡزَمۡنَٰهُ طَـٰٓئِرَهُۥ فِي عُنُقِهِۦۖ وَنُخۡرِجُ لَهُۥ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ كِتَٰبٗا يَلۡقَىٰهُ مَنشُورًا

candidates.label: Parental kindness decreed alongside tawheed as inseparable obligations
candidates.definition: In 17:23-24: Your Lord decreed worship none but Him and good to parents; if old age reaches say not uff speak noble word lower wing of mercy.

evidence.excerpt: ۞وَقَضَىٰ رَبُّكَ أَلَّا تَعۡبُدُوٓاْ إِلَّآ إِيَّاهُ وَبِٱلۡوَٰلِدَيۡنِ إِحۡسَٰنًاۚ إِمَّا يَبۡلُغَنَّ عِندَكَ ٱلۡكِبَرَ أَحَدُهُمَآ أَوۡ كِلَاهُمَا فَلَا تَقُل لَّهُمَآ أُفّٖ وَلَا تَنۡهَرۡهُمَا وَقُل لَّهُمَا قَوۡلٗا كَرِيمٗا

candidates.label: Cosmic signs enabling temporal navigation and calendar
candidates.definition: In 17:12: We made night day signs erased sign of night made sign of day visible seeking bounty from Lord knowing number years and account.

evidence.excerpt: وَجَعَلۡنَا ٱلَّيۡلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ ءَايَتَيۡنِۖ فَمَحَوۡنَآ ءَايَةَ ٱلَّيۡلِ وَجَعَلۡنَآ ءَايَةَ ٱلنَّهَارِ مُبۡصِرَةٗ لِّتَبۡتَغُواْ فَضۡلٗا مِّن رَّبِّكُمۡ وَلِتَعۡلَمُواْ عَدَدَ ٱلسِّنِينَ وَٱلۡحِسَابَۚ وَكُلَّ شَيۡءٖ فَصَّلۡنَٰهُ تَفۡصِيلٗا

candidates.label: Epistemic humility prohibiting pursuit beyond faculties
candidates.definition: In 17:36: Do not pursue that of which you have no knowledge; hearing sight heart all will be questioned.

evidence.excerpt: وَلَا تَقۡفُ مَا لَيۡسَ لَكَ بِهِۦ عِلۡمٌۚ إِنَّ ٱلسَّمۡعَ وَٱلۡبَصَرَ وَٱلۡفُؤَادَ كُلُّ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ كَانَ عَنۡهُ مَسۡـُٔولٗا

candidates.label: Anti-arrogance command with physical impossibility demonstration
candidates.definition: In 17:37: Do not walk upon earth arrogantly; you will never tear mountains nor reach height of stars.

evidence.excerpt: وَلَا تَمۡشِ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مَرَحًاۖ إِنَّكَ لَن تَخۡرِقَ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَلَن تَبۡلُغَ ٱلۡجِبَالَ طُولٗا

candidates.label: Wisdom as selective divine grant enabling remembrance
candidates.definition: In 17:39: That is from what your Lord revealed of wisdom; whoever granted wisdom granted much good; none remembers except understanding.

evidence.excerpt: ذَٰلِكَ مِمَّآ أَوۡحَىٰٓ إِلَيۡكَ رَبُّكَ مِنَ ٱلۡحِكۡمَةِۗ وَلَا تَجۡعَلۡ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتُلۡقَىٰ فِي جَهَنَّمَ مَلُومٗا مَّدۡحُورًا

candidates.label: Infanticide prohibition grounded in divine provision guarantee
candidates.definition: In 17:31: Do not kill your children fearing poverty; We provide for them and for you; their killing is great sin.

evidence.excerpt: وَلَا تَقۡتُلُوٓاْ أَوۡلَٰدَكُمۡ خَشۡيَةَ إِمۡلَٰقٖۖ نَّحۡنُ نَرۡزُقُهُمۡ وَإِيَّاكُمۡۚ إِنَّ قَتۡلَهُمۡ كَانَ خِطۡـٔٗا كَبِيرٗا

existingTopicOverlap.note: Child life protected by rizq guarantee.

candidates.label: Sexual immorality classified as indecency and evil path
candidates.definition: In 17:32: Do not approach zina; it is fahisha and evil way.

evidence.excerpt: وَلَا تَقۡرَبُواْ ٱلزِّنَىٰٓۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فَٰحِشَةٗ وَسَآءَ سَبِيلٗا

candidates.label: Murder prohibition with just-cause exception and heir authority
candidates.definition: In 17:33: Do not kill soul Allah forbidden except by right; whoever killed unjustly given authority to heir not exceed in killing.

evidence.excerpt: وَلَا تَقۡتُلُواْ ٱلنَّفۡسَ ٱلَّتِي حَرَّمَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا بِٱلۡحَقِّۗ وَمَن قُتِلَ مَظۡلُومٗا فَقَدۡ جَعَلۡنَا لِوَلِيِّهِۦ سُلۡطَٰنٗا فَلَا يُسۡرِف فِّي ٱلۡقَتۡلِۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مَنصُورٗا

candidates.label: Orphan property protection as fiduciary obligation until maturity
candidates.definition: In 17:34: Do not approach orphan property except in best way until reaching maturity.

evidence.excerpt: وَلَا تَقۡرَبُواْ مَالَ ٱلۡيَتِيمِ إِلَّا بِٱلَّتِي هِيَ أَحۡسَنُ حَتَّىٰ يَبۡلُغَ أَشُدَّهُۥۚ وَأَوۡفُواْ بِٱلۡعَهۡدِۖ إِنَّ ٱلۡعَهۡدَ كَانَ مَسۡـُٔولٗا

candidates.label: Commercial justice through honest measurement and weighing
candidates.definition: In 17:35: Give full measure when measuring weigh with just scales; that is better and best determination.

evidence.excerpt: وَأَوۡفُواْ ٱلۡكَيۡلَ إِذَا كِلۡتُمۡ وَزِنُواْ بِٱلۡقِسۡطَاسِ ٱلۡمُسۡتَقِيمِۚ ذَٰلِكَ خَيۡرٞ وَأَحۡسَنُ تَأۡوِيلٗا

candidates.label: Covenant fulfillment as accountable obligation
candidates.definition: In 17:34: Fulfill the covenant; indeed the covenant will be questioned about.

evidence.excerpt: وَلَا تَقۡرَبُواْ مَالَ ٱلۡيَتِيمِ إِلَّا بِٱلَّتِي هِيَ أَحۡسَنُ حَتَّىٰ يَبۡلُغَ أَشُدَّهُۥۚ وَأَوۡفُواْ بِٱلۡعَهۡدِۖ إِنَّ ٱلۡعَهۡدَ كَانَ مَسۡـُٔولٗا

candidates.label: Shirk consequence as disgrace and abandonment
candidates.definition: In 17:22: Do not set up another deity with Allah lest you sit disgraced abandoned.

evidence.excerpt: لَّا تَجۡعَلۡ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَقۡعُدَ مَذۡمُومٗا مَّخۡذُولٗا

candidates.label: Universal term principle preventing premature judgment
candidates.definition: In 17:49: Every nation has appointed term; when term comes cannot delay hour nor advance it.

evidence.excerpt: وَقَالُوٓاْ أَءِذَا كُنَّا عِظَٰمٗا وَرُفَٰتًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبۡعُوثُونَ خَلۡقٗا جَدِيدٗا

candidates.label: Provision expansion-restriction as divine prerogative
candidates.definition: In 17:30: Indeed your Lord extends provision for whom He wills and restricts; He is ever Knowing Seeing of His servants.

evidence.excerpt: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَبۡسُطُ ٱلرِّزۡقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقۡدِرُۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ بِعِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرَۢا بَصِيرٗا

candidates.label: Closing worship-tasbih-sujud triad extending until death
candidates.definition: In 17:111: Say praise to Allah who has not taken son nor partner nor protector from weakness; magnify Him greatly.

evidence.excerpt: وَقُلِ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي لَمۡ يَتَّخِذۡ وَلَدٗا وَلَمۡ يَكُن لَّهُۥ شَرِيكٞ فِي ٱلۡمُلۡكِ وَلَمۡ يَكُن لَّهُۥ وَلِيّٞ مِّنَ ٱلذُّلِّۖ وَكَبِّرۡهُ تَكۡبِيرَۢا

candidates.label: Iblis refusal rooted in material superiority claim over clay creation
candidates.definition: In 17:61: When We said to angels prostrate to Adam they prostrated except Iblis; said should I prostrate to one You created from clay?

evidence.excerpt: وَإِذۡ قُلۡنَا لِلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ ٱسۡجُدُواْ لِأٓدَمَ فَسَجَدُوٓاْ إِلَّآ إِبۡلِيسَ قَالَ ءَأَسۡجُدُ لِمَنۡ خَلَقۡتَ طِينٗا

candidates.label: Satanic multi-directional strategy limited by divine protection
candidates.definition: In 17:62-65: Incite with voice assault with horses foot soldiers share wealth offspring make promises; over My servants no authority.

evidence.excerpt: قَالَ أَرَءَيۡتَكَ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي كَرَّمۡتَ عَلَيَّ لَئِنۡ أَخَّرۡتَنِ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ لَأَحۡتَنِكَنَّ ذُرِّيَّتَهُۥٓ إِلَّا قَلِيلٗا

candidates.label: Quran inimitability challenge despite jinn-human cooperation
candidates.definition: In 17:88: Say if mankind and jinn gathered to produce like this Quran they could not produce its like even mutual support.

evidence.excerpt: قُل لَّئِنِ ٱجۡتَمَعَتِ ٱلۡإِنسُ وَٱلۡجِنُّ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَأۡتُواْ بِمِثۡلِ هَٰذَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ لَا يَأۡتُونَ بِمِثۡلِهِۦ وَلَوۡ كَانَ بَعۡضُهُمۡ لِبَعۡضٖ ظَهِيرٗا

candidates.label: Gradual revelation enabling paced recitation and comprehension
candidates.definition: In 17:106: Quran We separated by intervals (faraqnahu) that you might recite to people over prolonged period; sent down gradually.

evidence.excerpt: وَقُرۡءَانٗا فَرَقۡنَٰهُ لِتَقۡرَأَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ عَلَىٰ مُكۡثٖ وَنَزَّلۡنَٰهُ تَنزِيلٗا

candidates.label: Truth-arrival falsehood-perishing as eschatological certainty
candidates.definition: In 17:81: Say truth has come and falsehood has perished; indeed falsehood is ever-perishing.

evidence.excerpt: وَقُلۡ جَآءَ ٱلۡحَقُّ وَزَهَقَ ٱلۡبَٰطِلُۚ إِنَّ ٱلۡبَٰطِلَ كَانَ زَهُوقٗا

candidates.label: Quran as healing and mercy for believers increasing wrongdoers in loss
candidates.definition: In 17:82: We send down Quran as healing and mercy for believers; it increases wrongdoers only in loss.

evidence.excerpt: وَنُنَزِّلُ مِنَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ مَا هُوَ شِفَآءٞ وَرَحۡمَةٞ لِّلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَلَا يَزِيدُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا خَسَارٗا

candidates.label: Disbeliever miracle demands catalogued and deferred
candidates.definition: In 17:90-93: Demands for spring garden palace river gold tablet angel; responded nothing prevented except prior denial pattern.

evidence.excerpt: وَقَالُواْ لَن نُّؤۡمِنَ لَكَ حَتَّىٰ تَفۡجُرَ لَنَا مِنَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ يَنۢبُوعًا

candidates.label: Divine sufficiency against mockers replacing prophetic anxiety
candidates.definition: In 17:95: Say sufficient is your Lord as guardian between me and you; He is ever Seeing Knowing of His servants.

evidence.excerpt: قُل لَّوۡ كَانَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مَلَـٰٓئِكَةٞ يَمۡشُونَ مُطۡمَئِنِّينَ لَنَزَّلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَلَكٗا رَّسُولٗا

candidates.label: Satanic promises as deception producing only delusion
candidates.definition: In 17:64: Make promises to them; Satan promises them only delusion (ghurur).

evidence.excerpt: وَٱسۡتَفۡزِزۡ مَنِ ٱسۡتَطَعۡتَ مِنۡهُم بِصَوۡتِكَ وَأَجۡلِبۡ عَلَيۡهِم بِخَيۡلِكَ وَرَجِلِكَ وَشَارِكۡهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَمۡوَٰلِ وَٱلۡأَوۡلَٰدِ وَعِدۡهُمۡۚ وَمَا يَعِدُهُمُ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ إِلَّا غُرُورًا

candidates.label: Hell as sufficient recompense for satanic followers
candidates.definition: In 17:63: Whoever follows you among them Hell will be recompense ample and sufficient.

evidence.excerpt: قَالَ ٱذۡهَبۡ فَمَن تَبِعَكَ مِنۡهُمۡ فَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ جَزَآؤُكُمۡ جَزَآءٗ مَّوۡفُورٗا

candidates.label: Musa nine evident signs as prophetic authentication
candidates.definition: In 17:101: We gave Musa nine evident signs; ask Children of Israel when he came to them.

evidence.excerpt: وَلَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَا مُوسَىٰ تِسۡعَ ءَايَٰتِۭ بَيِّنَٰتٖۖ فَسۡـَٔلۡ بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَـٰٓءِيلَ إِذۡ جَآءَهُمۡ فَقَالَ لَهُۥ فِرۡعَوۡنُ إِنِّي لَأَظُنُّكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ مَسۡحُورٗا

candidates.label: Firawn dismissal as sorcery leading to collective drowning
candidates.definition: In 17:101-103: Firawn said I think you bewitched O Musa; said you know none sent these except Lord heavens earth as evidences; intended to drive out so We drowned him and all with him.

evidence.excerpt: وَلَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَا مُوسَىٰ تِسۡعَ ءَايَٰتِۭ بَيِّنَٰتٖۖ فَسۡـَٔلۡ بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَـٰٓءِيلَ إِذۡ جَآءَهُمۡ فَقَالَ لَهُۥ فِرۡعَوۡنُ إِنِّي لَأَظُنُّكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ مَسۡحُورٗا

candidates.label: Post-destruction Israelite settlement with eschatological gathering
candidates.definition: In 17:104: Said after Pharaoh to Children of Israel dwell in land; when promise of Hereafter comes We bring you forth in gathering.

evidence.excerpt: وَقُلۡنَا مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِۦ لِبَنِيٓ إِسۡرَـٰٓءِيلَ ٱسۡكُنُواْ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ فَإِذَا جَآءَ وَعۡدُ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ جِئۡنَا بِكُمۡ لَفِيفٗا

candidates.label: Quranic truthfulness in both sending and descending
candidates.definition: In 17:105: With truth We sent it down and with truth it descended; sent you only as bearer of glad tidings and warner.

evidence.excerpt: وَبِٱلۡحَقِّ أَنزَلۡنَٰهُ وَبِٱلۡحَقِّ نَزَلَۗ وَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَٰكَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرٗا وَنَذِيرٗا

candidates.label: Knowledge-bearers prostrate-weeping response demonstrating epistemic humility
candidates.definition: In 17:107-109: Those given knowledge before it fall upon faces weeping when recited; increases them in humble submission.

evidence.excerpt: قُلۡ ءَامِنُواْ بِهِۦٓ أَوۡ لَا تُؤۡمِنُوٓاْۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡعِلۡمَ مِن قَبۡلِهِۦٓ إِذَا يُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِمۡ يَخِرُّونَۤ لِلۡأَذۡقَانِۤ سُجَّدٗاۤ

candidates.label: Flexible divine naming with asma al-husna principle
candidates.definition: In 17:110: Say call upon Allah or call upon Rahman; whichever name you call to Him belong best names.

evidence.excerpt: قُلِ ٱدۡعُواْ ٱللَّهَ أَوِ ٱدۡعُواْ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنَۖ أَيّٗا مَّا تَدۡعُواْ فَلَهُ ٱلۡأَسۡمَآءُ ٱلۡحُسۡنَىٰۚ وَلَا تَجۡهَرۡ بِصَلَاتِكَ وَلَا تُخَافِتۡ بِهَا وَٱبۡتَغِ بَيۡنَ ذَٰلِكَ سَبِيلٗا

candidates.label: Closing tasbih affirming absolute divine uniqueness
candidates.definition: In 17:111: Praise to Allah who has not taken son nor partner in dominion nor protector from weakness; magnify Him greatly.

evidence.excerpt: وَقُلِ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي لَمۡ يَتَّخِذۡ وَلَدٗا وَلَمۡ يَكُن لَّهُۥ شَرِيكٞ فِي ٱلۡمُلۡكِ وَلَمۡ يَكُن لَّهُۥ وَلِيّٞ مِّنَ ٱلذُّلِّۖ وَكَبِّرۡهُ تَكۡبِيرَۢا

existingTopicOverlap.note: Triple negation: no son no sharik no wali.

candidates.label: Prayer volume moderation between loudness and silence
candidates.definition: In 17:110: Do not recite prayer aloud nor quietly seek between that a middle way.

evidence.excerpt: قُلِ ٱدۡعُواْ ٱللَّهَ أَوِ ٱدۡعُواْ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنَۖ أَيّٗا مَّا تَدۡعُواْ فَلَهُ ٱلۡأَسۡمَآءُ ٱلۡحُسۡنَىٰۚ وَلَا تَجۡهَرۡ بِصَلَاتِكَ وَلَا تُخَافِتۡ بِهَا وَٱبۡتَغِ بَيۡنَ ذَٰلِكَ سَبِيلٗا

candidates.label: Believer recognition of fulfilled divine promise
candidates.definition: In 17:108: They say exalted is our Lord indeed promise of our Lord has been fulfilled.

evidence.excerpt: وَيَقُولُونَ سُبۡحَٰنَ رَبِّنَآ إِن كَانَ وَعۡدُ رَبِّنَا لَمَفۡعُولٗا

candidates.label: Quran increasing believers in humble submission through recitation
candidates.definition: In 17:109: They fall upon faces weeping and it increases them in humble submission (khushu').

evidence.excerpt: وَيَخِرُّونَ لِلۡأَذۡقَانِ يَبۡكُونَ وَيَزِيدُهُمۡ خُشُوعٗا۩
